_comment: Tier-2 for febio::growth_remodeling#2. Two runs of the same growing block: constrained on three symmetry planes, J equals the growth multiplier cubed (computed by the fixture from the load curve, not quoted) and the stress stays at round-off; every outer node clamped, J stays at exactly 1, nothing moves, and the residual stress exceeds a tenth of the elastic modulus. Both reach normal termination with exit 0, all steps completed, no ERROR and no WARNING — there is no divergence to warn you, which is the whole claim. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
